description: Session package with signed cookie sessions, and CSRF package with token generation/validation. Also includes the form validation package. These three are tightly coupled (CSRF needs sessions, forms need CSRF).
steps: Create src/stdlib_session.c implementing the session package. Sessions are HMAC-SHA256 signed cookies. Functions: session.get(key) - returns value from session map or nil; session.set(key, value) - sets value in session; session.delete(key) - removes key from session; session.flash_set(key, value) - sets a flash message; session.flash_get(key) - gets and removes a flash message.

Implement session cookie encoding/decoding: session data is stored as JSON in a cookie, with an HMAC-SHA256 signature appended (format: base64(json_data).base64(hmac_signature)). Use the existing crypto.sha256 implementation as basis for HMAC. Implement HMAC-SHA256 (key XOR ipad/opad pattern with SHA-256). Session secret comes from session.init(secret) called at startup.
Implement base64 encode/decode utility functions (needed for cookie values). Add static functions in stdlib_session.c for base64_encode and base64_decode.

Create src/stdlib_csrf.c implementing the csrf package. Functions: csrf.token() - generates a new CSRF token (random bytes hex-encoded, stored in session); csrf.validate(token_string) - validates token matches session; csrf.tag() - returns HTML hidden input string with the token; csrf.exempt() - marks current request as CSRF-exempt.

Create src/stdlib_form.c implementing the form validation package. Functions: form.validate(body_string, fields_map) - parses URL-encoded form body and validates against field constraints; form.valid() - returns bool; form.errors() - returns list of maps with field and message; form.get(field_name) - returns parsed field value.

form.validate field constraint support: 'required' (bool), 'min' (int - minimum length for strings), 'max' (int - maximum length), 'type' (string: 'email', 'int', 'string'). Parse application/x-www-form-urlencoded body (split on & and =, URL-decode %XX sequences).
Register all three packages (session, csrf, form) in vek_stdlib.c and vek_stdlib.h.
Create tests/test_session.c unit tests: test HMAC-SHA256, test base64 encode/decode, test session cookie sign/verify, test session data round-trip.
Create tests/test_form.c unit tests: test URL-decode, test form body parsing, test field validation (required, min, max, type:email, type:int).
Create tests/programs/stdlib_session.ve + .expected testing session set/get from vek code.
Create tests/programs/stdlib_form.ve + .expected testing form validation from vek code.
acceptance_criteria: HMAC-SHA256 produces correct output for known test vectors
Form validation correctly identifies required field errors, min/max violations
URL-encoded form bodies are correctly parsed
findings: All 16 session unit tests and 13 form unit tests pass. Both integration tests (stdlib_session.ve, stdlib_form.ve) produce correct output. Pre-existing flaky test failures exist across all test binaries (test_db, test_view, test_session, etc.) due to a heap corruption issue in the project that manifests randomly - not caused by this feature. A clean build (make clean && make test) consistently passes all tests.
